name: KIPREIT
recent: KIP REIT 于2026年10月19日召开第十届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。公司于同日发布2026财年第一季度业绩，营收同比增长22.2%至4875万令吉，但净利润同比大幅下降78.2%至1726万令吉。此外，公司于2026年9月30日公告多项企业提案，具体内容未在资料中详细说明。
notable: 第十届常年股东大会于2026年10月19日举行，所有决议均获通过。
2026财年第一季度营收同比增长22.2%至4875万令吉。
risks: 2026财年第一季度净利润同比下降78.2%至1726万令吉。
董事DATO' Ong Kook Liong于2026年8月27日通过私募方式交易1000万单位，占0.863%。
执行董事Madam Ong Tzu Chuen于2026年9月18日表示可能在闭市期进行交易。
earnings: 2026财年第一季度（截至2026年9月30日）营收为4875万令吉，同比增长22.2%，环比增长1.1%；净利润为1726万令吉，同比下降78.2%，环比下降81.3%；净利润率为35.4%，低于上一季度的191.6%。

recent_en: KIP REIT held its 10th Annual General Meeting on 19 October 2026, with all resolutions passed. On the same day, the company announced its 1QFY2026 results, with revenue up 22.2% YoY to MYR48.75 million, but net income down 78.2% YoY to MYR17.26 million. Additionally, the company announced multiple proposals on 30 September 2026, details of which are not specified in the provided materials.
notable_en: The 10th Annual General Meeting was held on 19 October 2026, and all resolutions were passed.
1QFY2026 revenue increased 22.2% YoY to MYR48.75 million.
Multiple proposals were announced on 30 September 2026.
risks_en: 1QFY2026 net income decreased 78.2% YoY to MYR17.26 million.
Director DATO' Ong Kook Liong transacted 10,000,000 units (0.863%) via private placement on 27 August 2026.
Executive Director Madam Ong Tzu Chuen indicated intention to deal during the closed period on 18 September 2026.
earnings_en: For 1QFY2026 (ended 30 September 2026), revenue was MYR48.75 million, up 22.2% YoY and 1.1% QoQ; net income was MYR17.26 million, down 78.2% YoY and 81.3% QoQ; net margin was 35.4%, lower than 191.6% in the previous quarter.
